title: Accelerating Constrained Decoding with Token Space Compression
abstract: arXiv:2605.29986v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: To guarantee that an LLM's outputs conform to a specified structure, context-free grammar (CFG) decoding engines force the selection of next tokens to produce strings that conform to a given CFG. Current CFG-constrained decoding engines are highly optimized, but still suffer from the inherent costs arising from their massive per-step search space---i.e. the entire token vocabulary. This results in intractably high overhead for more complex CFGs, which is precisely the situation where CFG engines are most useful. In this paper, we introduce CFGzip, an offline technique for compressing the token search space, which massively reduces CFG engine overhead. In experiments, we report latency reduction of up to 75x during batched inference, cutting overhead down to ~1.2-2x on the hardest grammars: with CFGzip, constrained decoding is now possible at scale for complex CFGs

translated_title: 通过词元空间压缩加速受限解码
translated_abstract: 摘要：为了保证大语言模型（LLM）的输出符合指定的结构，上下文无关文法（CFG）解码引擎会强制约束下一个词元的选择，以生成符合给定CFG的字符串。当前的CFG受限解码引擎已经高度优化，但仍然受到其每步搜索空间庞大（即整个词元词表）所带来的固有成本困扰。这导致对于更复杂的CFG，开销会高得难以承受，而这恰恰是CFG引擎最有用武之地的场景。在本文中，我们提出了CFGzip，一种用于压缩词元搜索空间的离线技术，它大幅降低了CFG引擎的开销。在实验中，我们报告了批量推理期间延迟降低最高达75倍，在最难的文法上也将开销削减至约1.2-2倍：借助CFGzip，复杂CFG的受限解码现在得以大规模实现。
tldr: CFGzip通过离线压缩词元搜索空间，大幅降低CFG受限解码的开销，在批量推理中实现最高75倍的延迟加速，使复杂上下文无关文法的受限解码得以大规模应用。
en_tdlr: CFGzip compresses the token search space offline to drastically reduce CFG-constrained decoding overhead, achieving up to 75x latency speedup in batched inference and enabling constrained decoding for complex CFGs at scale.
